name: zed
description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
one_liner: A fast, modern app for writing and editing code, made by the team behind the Atom editor.
buyer: There isn't really an outside buyer here — it's a finished consumer product from a funded company, so there is little commercial room for a third party to build on top of it today.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools educator builds paid courses or tutorials specifically around Zed as its user base grows.
A plugin developer builds and sells premium Zed extensions (themes, language support) once its extension ecosystem matures further.
A consultancy offers 'migrate your team from VS Code to Zed' onboarding for performance-sensitive engineering teams.

money_ideas.idea: Paid migration/onboarding consulting for engineering teams

steal_this: Honestly, not much to steal here this weekend — it's a polished, well-funded consumer product, not raw material for a new business.
